item.title: Microsoft mega outage: Report reveals testing gaps and emails that never arrived
item.description: Some emails never reached their recipients during November's Microsoft 365 outage, the company has confirmed in a final report that also exposes gaps in its testing and recovery procedures. The post-incident report details how a Windows defect brought down Exchange Online and disrupted features across other Microsoft 365 services. For affected users, the cloud became someone else's unavailable computer. A preliminary report had already blamed a July code change, combined with a failover and reduced capacity. The final report confirms those findings and sets out Microsoft's plans to improve change auditing and recovery procedures, and add spare capacity. The defect affected Microsoft's gateway server configuration, not standard Windows deployments. The epic outage (named the "Microsoft long weekend" by some wags) kicked off on November 12 and wasn't fully resolved until November 14. Microsoft extended its delivery retry window to 48 hours, but some delayed messages destined for consumer mailboxes inactive for more than 30 days still expired, generating non-delivery reports. The company said all queued enterprise messages were eventually delivered, with none found permanently lost. The report is grim, particularly in how the failure ramped up as US users came online to find gateway servers toppling over. At the worst point, more than 80 percent of North American gateway servers were unresponsive. The problem proved elusive, and it took Microsoft some time to identify the change and deploy a fix. Microsoft has had a week to ponder what it did and did not do, and the report has some next steps to avoid a repeat of November's events. Some are obvious, and some are a little surprising. Working to reduce the blast radius of failures is an obvious one, and actions include partitioning and isolation to ensure failures can be contained before taking down traffic globally. Recovery procedures also need improvement, along with communication and capacity to ensure there is sufficient headroom. Microsoft's load tests used older, lower-core-count hardware, making them less likely to expose a defect that worsened on newer machines. The company now plans to test newer hardware with more realistic traffic and peak loads, and broaden its failover testing. Microsoft also plans to improve diagnostics and change auditing so engineers can identify troublesome Windows changes faster. July's defect had been running worldwide for more than three months before it brought the gateways down. ®

item.title: PFF Grades Reveal Detroit Lions’ Biggest Standouts From Win Over Buccaneers
item.description: The Detroit Lions beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 31-21 on Sunday , and the Detroit Lions PFF grades include a linebacker who needed only 25 snaps to make the list. Detroit improved to 8-2 on the season with the win, while Tampa Bay dropped to 3-7. Here are the top three Lions on each side of the ball, according to PFF . Detroit Lions quarterback Jared Goff (16) tucks the ball and runs for the first down while being chased by Tampa Bay Buccaneers outside linebacker Al-Quadin Muhammad (97) during the second half of the NFL game at Ford Field in Detroit, Sunday, Nov. 22, 2026. Credit: USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect (Reuters) Chuck Clark led the defense in Detroit Lions PFF grades Safety Chuck Clark led Detroit’s defense on PFF with a grade of 85.7. He played 69 snaps in the game. Clark had eight combined tackles (two solo), one sack, one TFL, and one pass deflection. He had another solid game for the Lions on defense. Linebacker Malcolm Rodriguez was ranked second on the Lions defense on PFF for this matchup against Tampa Bay. He played 55 snaps and had an 83.5 grade on PFF . Rodriguez had six tackles, 0.5 sacks, and one pass deflection. Linebacker K.J. Britt was ranked fifth overall in the game, and he was Detroit’s third-best defensive player. He had a 75.1 PFF grade and played just 25 snaps. Britt had three tackles and one TFL in the game. Jared Goff led the Lions offense on PFF Quarterback Jared Goff had a strong day for the Lions. He completed 20 of 28 passes for 279 yards and two touchdowns without an interception. Goff had the highest grade on offense for the team on PFF . He played 58 snaps and had a grade of 88.3. Jahmyr Gibbs and Jameson Williams round out the top three Running back Jahmyr Gibbs was ranked second on PFF for the Lions on offense. He had an 82.7 grade and played 43 snaps. Gibbs rushed for 98 yards and two touchdowns on 23 carries. He also had four receptions for 20 yards. Gibbs continues to be a workhorse for the Lions on offense. Wide receiver Jameson Williams was the third-best Lions offensive player on PFF, but he was ranked fourth overall in the game. Williams played 45 snaps and had a 74.5 PFF grade . He caught four passes for 93 yards, an average of 23.3 yards per reception, including a 57-yard touchdown. The Bears are next on Thanksgiving This was another huge game for the offense and defense. The Lions will need this kind of performance again in a Thanksgiving showdown with first place on the line against the Chicago Bears, who are also 8-2.

item.title: Nvidia Board Reinstates CEO Jensen Huang Less than 2 Weeks after He Resigned
item.description: Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as its CEO, president, and board director, the technology company announced on Monday. Huang's reinstatement comes less than two weeks after the embattled CEO resigned amid a scandal involving an alleged affair with a Chinese intelligence agent, multiple affairs with Nvidia employees, and allegations of workplace abuse .

item.title: TELEGRAPH: Williams-Barnett on the brink of a new Tottenham contract
item.description: LONDON, ENGLAND - NOVEMBER 21: Luca Williams-Barnett of Tottenham Hotspur is the centre of attention as his colleagues celebrate his opening goal during the Premier League 2026/27 match between Tottenham Hotspur and Ipswich Town at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium on November 21, 2026 in London, United Kingdom. (Photo by Mark Leech/Offside/Offside via Getty Images) | Offside via Getty Images Well, THAT didn’t take long! Two days after Luca Williams-Barnett introduced himself to the Premier League with a great flourish — scoring a goal and tallying an assist in his first ever Premier League start and leading Spurs to a 2-0 win over Ipswich Town — he’s on the verge of signing a lucrative new contract that will keep him at Tottenham Hotspur for the foreseeable future. According to Matt Law in the Telegraph , Williams-Barnett is very close to signing a new deal with Spurs that will lock down his future at the club. Williams-Barnett is one of the brightest young stars to come out of any Premier League academy in recent years, and the list of clubs that are interested in trying to buy him away from Spurs is long, but includes Chelsea and Borussia Dortmund. It’s also a very unique opportunity for Luca, who due to injuries to Savio, Wilson Odobert, and Mykhailo Mudryk, now has a claim to the starting left winger role at Spurs. Williams-Barnett is only 18 years old, but has made a significant splash in the league, probably as big a splash as any Tottenham academy grad since before Harry Kane. Interestingly, while left back appears to be his current position, Law cites people close to Spurs who suggest LWB could end up being an attacking midfield #10 in the future, and that’s likely his best position. The left wing position is crowded at Spurs (though injury certainly has opened a window for Luca), as is the #10 role, with James Maddison and Xavi Simons, as well as players like Mateus Fernandes, Omar Marmoush, and Conor Gallagher able to play there. But you can certainly make an argument that Maddison is unlikely to be around for too much longer as he ages, and LWB could easily rotate into the position alongside Simons and whoever else Spurs decide to bring in for the future. It’s an exciting time to be a Spurs fan, that’s for sure. Hopefully we’ll see Luca lining up for Tottenham for years to come.

item.title: Airports, public transport shut down amid national strike in Belgium
item.description: Belgium's prime minister on Monday set a new year-end deadline for his coalition government to agree a cost-cutting budget or face collapse. The announcement came as a national strike against the planned cuts grounded all flights in and out of Belgium. Public transport, schools and other public services also faced disruption. France 24's Dave Keating has the latest from Brussels.

item.title: Fantasy Football NFL Week 11: Ja'Marr Chase & Tee Higgins Headlines Perfect FanDuel MNF Showdown Lineup
item.description: Oct 11, 2026; Miami Gardens, Florida, USA; Cincinnati Bengals wide receiver Ja'Marr Chase (1) celebrates with wide receiver Tee Higgins (5) during the third quarter against the Miami Dolphins at Hard Rock Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Rich Storry-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect When the Cincinnati Bengals (7-2) visit the Washington Commanders (3-5-1) at Northwest Stadium on Monday, November 23, 2026, at 7:15 PM CST). Primetime DFS players get a full-blown track meet with the Bengals sitting as a 6-point road favorite. Joe Burrow is carving up defenses to the tune of 30.9 points per game (3rd in the NFL) and 298.9 passing yards per game, turning every Bengals drive into a potential slate-breaker. Capturing Cincinnati's relentless touchdown upside in your Captain slot while leveraging Washington's desperation pace on the other side to bury the field. item.title: ‘I’m the best in the world’: Giants star Abdul Carter sends a message to the NFL after dominant game
item.description: Nov 22, 2026; East Rutherford, New Jersey, USA; New York Giants linebacker Abdul Carter (3) on the field after the national anthem before the game against the Jacksonville Jaguars at MetLife Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Vincent Carchietta-Imagn Images New York Giants linebacker Abdul Carter came into Sunday’s game against the Jacksonville Jaguars facing plenty of questions about his lack of sacks this season. He spent the week promising that he would show the world what he could do, and then he went out and did exactly that. Carter recorded two sacks, hit Trevor Lawrence five times, and was credited with 12 pressures in the Giants’ 23-18 win. And after the game, the second-year star didn’t hold back, declaring that he is “the best in the world.” Abdul Carter’s Slow Start The Giants took Carter with the No. 3 pick in the 2025 NFL Draft, but his rookie season was a rocky one. He finished with just four sacks and was benched twice for off-field issues. Carter set a goal of winning Defensive Player of the Year in his second season. But he entered Sunday with just two sacks through nine games and had gone four straight games without one, though he has faced more double-teams with Pro Bowl linebacker Brian Burns out since Week 3 with a torn ACL. Giants head coach John Harbaugh insisted last week that the production would come. “I believe the sacks will come. He’s a disruptive guy. I promise you they’re accounting for him, and the sacks are just going to come,” Harbaugh said, via The Associated Press . Carter was even more confident. After tweeting that he would show everyone on Sunday, he told NJ.com’s Darryl Slater what he planned to prove against the Jaguars. “I’m just going to show the world why I’m going to be the greatest ever. And that’s it. Simple as that,” Carter said. ‘I’m the Best in the World’ Carter backed it up in a big way on Sunday, putting pressure on Lawrence all afternoon as the Giants built a 20-6 halftime lead and held on for the win. The Giants improved to 6-3-1 and kept their lead in the NFC East, despite being on their third starting quarterback of the season in J.J. McCarthy. After the game, Carter did not hold back when asked about the win. “As a defense, we showed what we really about. And for me, I’m the best in the world,” Carter said, via NFL on CBS . He doubled down in the locker room when he was reminded that he promised to show why he would be the greatest ever. “I’m the best in the world,” Carter said, via the Giants . Carter said that the Giants took it personally that so many people expected the Jaguars to win. “Yeah, we heard, you know, everybody pretty much counted us out saying we pretty much had no chance. We couldn’t stick with their offense, but we just took that as disrespect. We came out with a chip on our shoulder,” Carter said. “I think we proved that we worthy. Like I just said, like they keep saying we can’t beat these teams. We can’t perform well against these teams. And I don’t know why they saying that, b

item.title: Jets & Chargers combine for NFL history not seen in over 50 years
item.description: The New York Jets and Los Angeles Chargers made NFL history on Sunday, producing a statistical oddity that had not been seen in more than five decades during their Week 11 matchup. The Jets narrowly defeated the Chargers 27-24, but the biggest story from the contest may have been the unusually low number of offensive possessions. The two teams combined for just 12 total drives throughout the game, marking the fewest combined drives in an NFL game since 1975. Jets-Chargers sets an NFL record (since 1975) with the fewest number of drives, just 12. (hat tip: @QuirkyResearch) — Aaron Schatz 🏈 (@ASchatzNFL) November 22, 2026 Despite neither team enjoying the season they envisioned entering 2026, their meeting delivered a historic performance that will certainly stand out in the league’s record books. MORE: Jets rookie David Bailey makes NFL history in first 10 career games Jets get off to a fast start Nov 22, 2026; Inglewood, California, USA; New York Jets Sterling Shepard (87) scores a touchdown during the fourth quarter against the Los Angeles Chargers at SoFi Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Jayne Kamin-Oncea-Imagn Images New York wasted little time getting its offense rolling, scoring touchdowns on each of its first five drives to establish early control of the contest. Quarterback Geno Smith delivered an efficient performance, completing 17 of 21 passing attempts for 176 yards and three touchdowns. Wide receiver Sterling Shepard also enjoyed a memorable afternoon, catching two touchdown passes in the same game for the first time in his NFL career. The Jets also received another outstanding performance from rookie linebacker David Bailey, who continued his impressive debut season. Bailey recorded two sacks against Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert, adding to his already historic rookie campaign. Through his first 10 career games, Bailey became the first rookie since sacks and forced fumbles became official statistics in 1982 to record at least 9.5 sacks and six forced fumbles. MORE: Tom Brady calls out NFL players for extravagant touchdown celebrations Herbert takes a beating in Chargers loss Nov 22, 2026; Inglewood, California, USA; New York Jets linebacker Jamien Sherwood (44) makes a tackle on Los Angeles Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert (10) during the fourth quarter at SoFi Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Jayne Kamin-Oncea-Imagn Images On the other side, Herbert struggled to find much offensive success against the Jets’ defense. The Chargers quarterback completed 15 of 21 passes for just 131 yards, while being brought down for six sacks throughout the afternoon. Herbert’s health also became a concern following the loss, as he entered concussion protocol after the game. The Chargers have yet to announce whether the injury will affect his availability for their Week 12 matchup against the New England Patriots. For the Jets, Sunday’s victory provided a rare positive moment in an otherwise difficult season. However, the historic nature of their matchup

item.title: USA joint bid and UK confirmed as 2031 and 2035 Women's World Cup hosts
item.description: FIFA announced Monday that the USA will co-host the 2031 Women's World Cup with Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica, while the UK will host in 2035 (OZAN KOSE) FIFA on Monday confirmed that a joint bid led by the United States will host the expanded, 48-team Women's World Cup in 2031, while the United Kingdom will host the following edition in 2035. The winning bids were waved through by acclamation after FIFA president Gianni Infantino confirmed the USA in partnership with Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica was the "sole candidacy" to host in 2031, when the tournament will feature 48 teams for the first time. The joint English, Scottish, Northern Irish and Welsh bid was also the only candidacy for 2035. Infantino had already revealed last year that the respective bids for 2031 and 2035 were unchallenged and therefore set to be awarded the tournaments, with both being officially rubber-stamped at a virtual gathering of FIFA's member associations. "As of 2031 there will be 48 teams and four hosts," said Infantino. "This is an incredible growth in just a few years." The next Women's World Cup will take place next year in Brazil, running from June 24 to July 25. It will feature 32 teams, with the final at the Maracana Stadium in Rio de Janeiro. Spain go into that tournament as the holders after winning the last Women's World Cup held in Australia and New Zealand in 2023, when they defeated current European champions England in the final. The US co-hosted this year's men's World Cup, with the majority of matches being played on American soil, including the final at the MetLife Stadium in New Jersey which was won by Spain. That was the first men's edition featuring 48 teams. The USA has hosted the Women's World Cup twice before, in 1999 and 2003, and is also the most successful nation in the tournament's history, having lifted the trophy four times. - 'Landmark moment' - US Soccer reacted to the announcement by saying the awarding of the 2031 tournament gave the country the chance to "build on the momentum" of this year's World Cup as well as the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. The United States are the reigning Olympic women's football champions. No senior men's or women's World Cup has been played in the UK since England hosted and won the men's edition in 1966. A joint statement by the four UK national associations described the announcement as "a landmark moment". It is not yet known which cities will host matches at the respective tournaments, but most matches in 2031 are likely to take place in the United States while England can expect to have the lion's share of venues in 2035. The draw for the 2027 Women's World Cup will take place on Friday, December 11, in Rio de Janeiro. The USA and England are among the nations aiming to secure qualification for the finals before then. item.title: 2026 Dodgers season review: Emmet Sheehan
item.description: LOS ANGELES, CALIFORNIA - JULY 12: Emmet Sheehan #80 of the Los Angeles Dodgers pitches during the second inning against the Arizona Diamondbacks at Dodger Stadium on July 12, 2026 in Los Angeles, California. (Photo by Ryan Sun/Getty Images) | Getty Images For a second straight season, Emmet Sheehan provided a strong finish to engender confidence going forward. Though in 2026, his ride was much bumpier along the way. In 2025, Sheehan made his way back from a hybrid Tommy John/internal brace surgery on his right elbow in midseason , then put together a strong three months while fortifying a six-pitcher rotation before pitching in relief in the postseason. This year, Sheehan was in the rotation from the jump but had spotty results before getting optioned in early August. But he found something in Triple-A, and looked great in his final six weeks in both the minors and majors. Sheehan started the season in the starting rotation and remained there for over four months, with mixed results. Through 20 starts, the right-hander ranked 96th among the 105 major league pitchers with at least 90 innings to that point in ERA (5.29) but was a more-respectable 46th in xERA (3.99) to that point . But it’s hard to plead using expected stats when the ball keeps flying over the fence. Sheehan allowed 20 home runs in those first 20 starts, including three hit by the Boston Red Sox in a particularly disappointing start on August 2 , in which Sheehan recorded only eight outs. Sheehan was optioned to Triple-A Oklahoma City the next day . He turned things around in Triple-A, winning Pacific Coast League pitcher of the month for August before returning to the Dodgers in September. After one planned brief appearance in his first game back in Triple-A, Sheehan over his last seven outings — four with Oklahoma City, including starting the Triple-A championship game on September 26 , plus three with the Dodgers — had a minuscule 0.91 ERA and 36.7-percent strikeout rate in 39 2/3 innings. A big concern for Sheehan earlier in the season was him holding his velocity throughout his starts. On the season, his fastball averaged 94.4 mph, down a tick from his first two major league seasons. But during that minor league stint, Sheehan found a way to make his fastball more effective with a tweak to his pitch usage. “It’s something, Connor [McGuiness, assistant pitching coach], Mark [Prior, pitching coach], and I and the coaches down at Triple-A have been working on a lot is expanding the front-to-back game with the fastball and the curveball,” Sheehan said in September . “Some guys ended up throughout the season sitting more mid-speed, slider, changeup on me. I think having that change of speeds has been really important.” Sheehan was on the outside looking in in October, left off the Dodgers rosters for both the National League Division Series and National League Championship Series. item.title: Bucks to continue to push league for NBA All-Star game in Milwaukee
item.description: Despite losing the 2028 NBA All-Star Game to Miami, the Milwaukee Bucks will continue pushing NBA officials for the event. The club believes Milwaukee has everything the NBA needs to host such an event. “We’re going to constantly bring it up with the league,” said Bucks president Josh Glessing. “The opportunity to showcase Milwaukee via the All-Star Game is so important. The economic impact and activity it creates in a region is so powerful." Glessing admits the pitch for Milwaukee does have some "challenges." “What we know is there’s a minimum threshold of hotel rooms and we have work to do there,” Glessing said adding the team has helped build two new hotels in The Trade and AC Hotel by Marriot which is currently under construction. The NBA requires the host city of the All-Star Game to have 7,250 hotel rooms. According to Visit Milwaukee there are 190 hotel properties in the area equaling about 20,000 rooms. It's unclear how many four and five-star hotels are required for the host city. Visit Milwaukee has not talked to the NBA about Milwaukee hosting the all-star game but is supportive of a bid. More: Milwaukee Bucks approach new challenge: getting fans engaged, in seats Glessing is not a stranger to All-Star Games. When he was interim-president of business operations for the Columbus Crew, the organization hosted the MLS All-Star Game in 2024. Glessing said for the team, the All-Star Game is a "money loser" but an event like that has broader economic potential for a city. “It’s a tremendous amount of work and the local teams put so much effort into it, but for the teams it is not a boon in any stretch,” Glessing said. “But for the local economy its so powerful, it’s so impactful to all of the people and activity and dollars that are spent locally. It’s not just a one-day event, it’s a weeklong event. So, the ability to highlight the city is huge.” This article originally appeared on Milwaukee Journal Sentinel: Bucks to continue to push league for NBA All-Star game in Milwaukee

item.title: Do Cowboys Fans Have Playoff Hope During Thanksgiving Week?
item.description: turkey dak jerry Somebody once said, “Hope is not a plan.” But what if “hope” is just about all you have left to cling to? The Dallas Cowboys crushed the lowly Tennessee Titans, 51-30, Sunday at AT&T Stadium and in doing so fueled optimism inside the locker room. “It gives me hope that we can do some of the things that we want to do,” said owner Jerry Jones (who was technically standing outside the locker room, but you get the point). “We want to get better defensively, and we want to execute like that offensively. “That thing went exactly like it was mapped out to go.” That rings true. Dak Prescott had a historic day, going 28-of-33 for 325 yards and four TDs, while the offense scored TDs on its first six possessions. And on defense? Oh, they gave up yards and they gave up points, but Quinnen Williams led the charge on a five-sack day, capping a week in which young defensive coordinator Christian Parker was demoted , with Mike Pettine now the play-caller. But later in the day came the problem. The Cowboys may have “mapped out” a win, and they can do the same thing as it regards a pursuit of the NFC East title and a playoff berth. But once Jerry and the ’Boys got home to do some scoreboard-watching? They discovered that the Giants pulled off a 23-18 upset over the Jacksonville Jaguars, moving New York to 6-3-1 … meaning that even though Dallas is 5-6, no ground was actually gained. Can Cowboys Nation allow itself to get excited about topping the one-win Titans? Hey, Dallas has lost home games to the Bucs and the Cardinals, so you take the win. Can Dallas fans count on a Thanksgiving win over the visiting (and semi-tanking) Philadelphia Eagles on Thursday? Hey, Dallas is an 8.5-point favorite , so that’s a start. But in the end, does it add up to playoff “hope” for Dallas? Cowboys Nation, you will have to make up your own mind on that one.

item.title: Eagles star Joe Milton reveals the secret trick he uses every time just before he throws a deep pass
item.description: Photo by Mitchell Leff/Getty Images The Philadelphia Eagles picked up a 19-16 upset win over the Pittsburgh Steelers, and Joe Milton played his part. The 26-year-old quarterback was only signed in October this year, following Jalen Hurts’ injury, and he has now started back-to-back games. Against the Steelers, Milton showed off his passing ability, and he revealed the trick he uses to program his mind not to overthrow. Joe Milton says his daughter’s name before every deep pass Milton played a turnover-free, game-manager role in his second start for the Philadelphia Eagles on Sunday. The quarterback seemed to develop a good partnership with DeVonta Smith, targeting him 12 times out of his 21 pass attempts. One of his pass attempts flew over the wide receiver’s head, much to his surprise. “I didn’t think I could get overthrown. And he did it,” Smith said. After the game, Milton was asked how he decides when to go hard and when not to when he’s in the middle. The quarterback revealed that his secret trick involves using his daughter’s name. He said, as per NBCS Philly: “Just showing a little love. In throws like that, I usually say my daughter’s name. It helps me relax. I didn’t that time (overthrown pass to Smith), obviously. “Right before I throw the ball, just get a quick little ‘Maleia’, just so I can relax a little bit. Basically, it kind of tells myself and my mind that I’m throwing the ball to her, so it can’t be as hard. “So, show a little love.” Sunday was the first time Smith and Milton played together for the Philadelphia Eagles, and early signs are definitely positive. The quarterback finished the game with 141 passing yards while completing 11 of his 21 passes, boasting a 73.7 passer rating. He also added seven rushing yards on five carries and took three sacks. Milton hasn’t thrown a touchdown pass for the Eagles yet, but he is in line to start against the Dallas Cowboys next, who are his former team. We’re sure he would love to break his duck then. item.title: Kyle Hamilton's humble mumble only hints at Jesse Minter's mediocrity
item.description: Baltimore Ravens head coach Jesse Minter wasn't hired to be a team ambassador in 2026; he was selected from a pool of premier candidates and projected to bring positives to the franchise. Instead, Minter has refused to make the needed adjustments on defense and the kind endorsement of safety Kyle Hamilton in yesterday's post-game conference will only fuel the disdain of Ravens' fans who believe Minter has greatly underachieved. After the 35-33 loss to the Carolina Panthers , Hamilton told the press that he believes Minter has done a "great job" in 2026. The statistics however tell a very different story. Through Week 11, the Ravens rank No. 18 in total yards allowed in 2026 and No. 26 in total points allowed per game. Unless Merriam-Webster has changed the definition for the word great, Hamilton's heart-felt humble sentiments should be taken with a grain of salt. Minter has not only been the opposite of great, but his stubborn dedication to his Zone-blitz scheme on pivotal downs has also continued to leave voids for opposing quarterbacks to exploit. Sunday, Panthers quarterback Bryce Young diced the Ravens for 254 passing yards while Panthers running back Chuba Hubbard also had a field day with 27 rushing attempts and 127 rushing yards. The sequence that matters most came after Derrick Henry gave the Ravens a 33-32 lead in the fourth quarter. Minter, who calls Baltimore’s defense, said afterward that he thought the Ravens had good coverage on one of the late third downs and that he could have put them in a better position on the other. Carolina went on to kick the winning field goal. Baltimore’s four turnovers help explain why the margin was so thin. Minter’s own assessment gives the Ravens a specific defensive decision to revisit when they review how they lost the lead. Coach Minter on the loss to Carolina. https://t.co/w0bxQ3PokO — Baltimore Ravens (@Ravens) November 22, 2026 Defensive prowess was where Minter was deemed as a professional mastermind but Ravens' fans have not seen even a glimpse of this propaganda. In fact, critics have even called the Ravens' defensive roster lack luster despite personnel groups loaded with proven NFL talent. As the Ravens and Minter sit at the bottom of the AFC North with a 4-7 2026 record, there will be talks about whether Minter deserves to be the head coach of this team whether his supporters agree or not. The Ravens have given up 119 passing first downs in 2026 , a major disappointment despite Minter's reputation as a pass defense guru. Hamilton can plead Minter's case all he wants; his lack of positives on the field cannot be pardoned by podium posture and fake pompousness. This article originally appeared on Ravens Wire: Kyle Hamilton's humble mumble only hints at Jesse Minter's mediocrity

item.title: Rockets vs. Clippers Prediction: Preview, Injury Report, Advantages, X-Factors
item.description: Mandatory Credit: Troy Taormina-Imagn Images The Houston Rockets welcome the Los Angeles Clippers to Toyota Center on Monday, November 23, with tipoff scheduled for 8:30 p.m. ET. The Rockets enter at 12-5 and have won three consecutive home games. Their latest outing, however, was a 133-124 loss to the Denver Nuggets , giving Houston something to address defensively before returning home. The Clippers arrive at 4-11 following a 110-100 defeat against the Dallas Mavericks . Los Angeles has lost three straight games, but Brandon Ingram’s expected season debut gives the visitors a significant addition. The challenge is integrating him against a Rockets team with considerably stronger results and offensive production. Injury Report Rockets None Clippers Bradley Beal: Out (Right knee injury management) Jordan Miller: Out (Left rotator cuff surgery) Why The Rockets Have The Advantage? Houston’s offense provides the clearest separation. The Rockets rank first in offensive rating at 121.1, tied for 13th in defensive rating at 113.2, and fifth in net rating at plus-7.9. The Clippers sit 24th offensively at 110.6, 25th defensively at 117.1, and 23rd in net rating at minus-6.4. That is a substantial difference in performance across both ends. The Rockets also rank fifth in scoring at 118.2 points per game and third in both field-goal percentage, at 48.5%, and three-point percentage, at 38.0%. Their offense creates several problems simultaneously: efficient interior scoring, perimeter threats, and enough passing to punish defensive help. Alperen Sengun is central to that structure, averaging 22.1 points, 9.3 rebounds, and 7.0 assists. Houston can establish him inside and let him determine whether to attack his defender or move the ball. Sending an extra defender carries a cost because he can find cutters and shooters before the defense recovers. Kevin Durant supplies a different challenge with averages of 21.0 points, 5.2 rebounds, and 3.8 assists. When an initial action breaks down, the Rockets still have a scorer who can create a workable shot against a set defense. Amen Thompson adds pressure through movement and athleticism, averaging 16.1 points, 7.1 rebounds, and 3.1 assists. His opportunities should come from cutting behind defenders watching Sengun, attacking unsettled possessions, and pursuing rebounds. Why The Clippers Have The Advantage? The Clippers’ strongest statistical weapon is perimeter shooting. Los Angeles ranks second in three-point percentage at 38.7% and ninth in made threes at 14.6 per game. That shooting gives the visitors a realistic way to overcome Houston’s broader advantages, particularly if they generate clean attempts before the Rockets establish their defense. Darius Garland leads the offense with averages of 20.9 points, 2.1 rebounds, and 6.5 assists. His ability to change direction and manipulate ball screens will be important against Houston’s length. item.title: Arsenal interested in 12-goal Bayern star
item.description: Arsenal interested in 12-goal Bayern star Arsenal like Michael Olise and have him on their transfer shortlist, but they face competition from Real Madrid and difficulties in convincing Bayern Munich to sell. Photo by Marius Nordnes / Nordnes Foto/Getty Images Christian Falk reports that Arsenal are interested in signing Michael Olise from Bayern Munich , and there’s a lot of respect for the Gunners. But Falk believes a move to Real Madrid is more likely, with the Spanish club also clearly in for the winger. On top of that, Bayern are hopeful that they won’t have to sell Olise at all, and they’re looking to extend his contract. They’re reportedly ready to fight to keep him where he is. Even if the two parties can’t reach an agreement on a contract extension, Olise still has a deal lasting until 2029. It would be another couple of seasons before Bayern would have no choice but to let him go. Photo by Marius Nordnes / Nordnes Foto/Getty Images Olise has been in fantastic form this season, scoring 12 goals for Bayern in just 16 games, and assisting another seven. The German champions are unbeaten in all competitions in 2026/27. The 24-year-old’s only real disappointment has been the red card he picked up for two yellows against Viking FK . His one-match suspension saw him missing Bayern’s game against Arsenal. Photo by Marius Nordnes / Nordnes Foto/Getty Images Olise has been in similarly strong form for France, scoring five and assisting two in six Nations League games over the last two breaks. It’s really not hard to see why Arsenal, Real Madrid, and Bayern Munich would all have a serious interest in seeing Olise signing a contract with them. But that’s going to make it very difficult for the Gunners to come out on top. item.title: Grumpy Old Buckeye: Unpacking Ohio State’s 31-28 loss to Nebraska
item.description: LINCOLN, NE - NOVEMBER 21: Ohio State running back Bo Jackson (25) runs with the ball during the game between the Ohio State Buckeyes and the Nebraska Cornhuskers on November 21, 2026, at Memorial Stadium in Lincoln, NE. (Photo by Nathanial George/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images) | Icon Sportswire via Getty Images Mondays are objectively terrible for many working folks, but having to gather among other humans after a fourth Ohio State loss on the season is starting to feel like a special kind of torture. The last time the Buckeyes lost so many times in a season, this column had never been published before, so I’m in uncharted territory having to pick through the smoldering rubbish heap of yet another L, but here we are… Here is a partial list of what turned Midwestern nice into a Midwestern nightmare on Saturday. Disorganization starts at the top There are a lot of things going wrong with the Buckeyes these days, including a lot of preventable things that continue to pile up. It started early, with Ryan Day getting flagged for sideline interference on Jeremiah Smith’s first touchdown. The 15-yard penalty on the ensuing kickoff gave Nebraska starting position at its 37-yard line, helping the Huskers quickly tie the game. I don’t know if the Buckeyes were having communication issues, but the number of times the play clock ran way down and the use of timeouts to combat that was weird. Using a timeout on the first possession of the third quarter was costly, and using one to avoid a delay-of-game infraction when it was already third-and-a-mile seemed unnecessary (and the opposite of the earlier strategy of taking the five yards in the same situation). Late in the game, that mattered, as Ohio State was again far too deliberate while chasing a two-score game and did not have sufficient remaining timeouts to get the ball back at the end after pulling back within three points. If you’re going to expect the players to execute, the coaching staff has to stop putting them in difficult spots. Third downs matter Ohio State’s alarming third-down defensive (in)efficiency continues to be alarming. Nebraska went 10-for-16 on third downs, and on two of the six that the Buckeyes stopped, the Cornhuskers converted on fourth down (2/2). So, out of the 16 times Ohio State forced the hosts into a third-down situation, Nebraska picked up a first down on 12 of those times. Matt Patricia’s defense has fallen to 109th nationally in third-down efficiency. Only Michigan State, Rutgers, and Purdue are worse on third down in the Big Ten. Nowhere was that more obvious than on Nebraska’s answering touchdown drive that Day’s sideline penalty jumpstarted. Qua Russaw jumped offside on third-and-4, meaning the Huskers didn’t even have to convert; they simply had to accept the gift. The Cornhuskers finished that drive a perfect 4-of-4 on third downs and tied 7-7 on the scoreboard, with two of those conversions having to go six or more yards. item.title: Horizon League Recap Nov. 16-22: Robert Morris finally gets a Division-I win
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS, IN - MARCH 09: Robert Morris Colonials head coach Andy Toole talks to his team in the second half of play during the men's Horizon League Tournament college basketball game between the Robert Morris Colonials and the Detroit Mercy Titans on March 09, 2026 at Corteva Coliseum in Indianapolis, IN. (Photo by Jeffrey Brown/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images) | Icon Sportswire via Getty Images Wins were hard to come by in the Horizon League this week with the 12 teams picking up a combined seven victories over the last seven days. Even in a down week, we’re continuing to learn about every team with every game played. Here’s a few of the results that stood out to me from this past week. Horizon League Wins of the Week Purdue Fort Wayne 78, Bradley 73 The Mastodons have quietly ascended to 4-2 on the young season, and this win over Bradley is right there among the league’s best wins. DeAndre Craig Jr., unsurprisingly, was the catalyst, scoring 21 points and dishing out five assists. It was the balance, however, that helped Purdue Fort Wayne get it done on the road. EJ Mosley scored 15 points, Anthony Isaac Jr. added 14, and both Carl Thompson III and Tamaje Izuagbe pitched in 10 off the bench. As a team, the Mastodons were out-rebounded, coughed up more turnovers and committed more fouls, but offensive efficiency was the key. Purdue Fort Wayne shot 27-for-51 (53%) from the field, made 11 3-pointers and matched Bradley’s 13 makes at the line, while the Braves made 14 3-pointers, but shot just 40% from the field. Northern Illinois 86, Bowling Green 68 Matt Majkrzak’s starting backcourt has been lights out to start the season and the trend continued in a quality road win against Northern Illinois’ old friend Bowling Green. Max Weisbrod scored an efficient 24 points and spread the ball for seven assists, and David Douglas Jr. made another five 3-pointers in a 21-point effort. Minutes have come on a hit-or-miss basis for Jack Daugherty this season, but the Illinois State transfer got the start and made a difference on Saturday. His 16 points, including three 3-pointers and 6-for-7 shooting from the field was enough offense to supplement the big games from Weisbrod and Douglas as the Huskies emerged victorious. Robert Morris 84, New Mexico State 79 I know New Mexico State is yet to beat a Division-I opponent on the young season, but neither had Robert Morris, which is why this is a big win for the Colonials. None of the first four losses have been particularly bad for Robert Morris, as it was an underdog in each game but finally getting a Division-I win has to feel good for Andy Toole and his team. In this contest, the Colonials jumped out to a 12-point lead at halftime, before surrendering it, allowing a 50-point second half for the Aggies, but got it done in overtime. KJ Garris Jr. continues to be a bright spot and he led the way with 24 points on Sunday. Ace Valentine and Jalik Dunkley seem to be finding their footing as well, each scoring 14 p

item.title: Josh Allen Spots Rookie Jacob Rodriguez And Shows Massive Respect
item.description: Credit: Amber Searls-Imagn Images Josh Allen stayed on the field after the Bills beat the Dolphins 26-9 on Sunday just to find rookie linebacker Jacob Rodriguez. The Bills quarterback hunted down the Miami defender, hugged him, and exchanged quick words before heading to the locker room. This moment stood out because Allen usually leaves right after his postgame chat with the media. The game on Sunday, Nov. 22, was a tough night for Allen statistically, even though his team won big. He threw for 304 yards and a touchdown but also tossed two interceptions. Miami’s defense held him to a quarterback rating under 70 and sacked him three times. Rodriguez was a major part of that pressure, finishing with a team-high 13 tackles and one interception. Allen didn’t just leave it at a quick nod. He waited for the rookie to finish his own media obligations. Most veterans do not wait that long for a rookie from a rival team, especially one who just made their life hard. Phin Phanatic noted that Allen’s search showed real respect for the young player’s performance. The Rookie Who Stole the Show Rodriguez made his mark early in the game. He picked off Allen near the end of the first half. It was the second interception of the season for the rookie. Virginia’s Rodriguez began his collegiate tenure as an offensive role/QB after in 2021 then being selected as an All-American linebacker from Texas Tech – 43rd overall in the 2026 class. That shared background might be why Allen wanted to talk to him so badly. Heavy.com reported that fans on social media praised the gesture immediately. One user called it a “Top 10 football respect moment.” Even some Miami fans admitted they found it hard to hate Allen after seeing this. One fan wrote, “As a Dolphins [fan]… it’s hard not to like Josh Allen. He’s a good guy.” A Rare Quiet Game for Allen While the hug got the headlines, the game itself had a strange stat line for the Bills star. Andrew Siciliano pointed out that Allen did not have a single rushing attempt during the entire game. This was the first time in his nine-year NFL career that he played a full game without trying to run the ball. The Bills chose not to let Allen run on a goal-line sneak. James Cook received the handoff instead, scoring a one-yard touchdown. Allen admitted he was not happy with his own play despite the win. He said, “You got to play your best and tonight I don’t feel like I did.” He also noted that he had two bad decisions, one being a tipped pass. “So, got a lot to clean up,” Allen said in his postgame press conference. He added, “It’s very much a luxury to sit here, be 9-1 and be a little ticked off about how you played.” Now the Bills face a short week. They will host the Kansas City Chiefs on Thursday, Nov. 26. The next game for the Dolphins is Sunday, Nov. 29, against the New York Jets.

item.title: NSCIA to politicians: Keep 2027 campaign violence out of mosques
item.description: By Luminous Jannamike ABUJA – The Nigerian Supreme Council for Islamic Affairs (NSCIA) has condemned attacks in and around some mosques, warning politicians and other actors against using places of worship as grounds for violence and confrontation ahead of the 2027 general elections. The Council said no political disagreement, doctrinal differences or personal grievances could justify violence against worshippers, insisting that mosques must remain sanctuaries of worship and peace, not arenas for settling disputes. The warning was contained in a statement by the NSCIA Secretary-General, Prof. Ishaq Oloyede, on behalf of the Council, led by its President-General, the Sultan of Sokoto, Alhaji Muhammad Sa’ad Abubakar. Describing the attacks as reprehensible and fundamentally contrary to Islamic teachings, the Council stressed that every Muslim had a duty to respect the sanctity of mosques and protect the lives and dignity of worshippers. “These teachings leave no room for violence, intimidation, harassment, assault, attack on or threat against people’s safety and lives in the name of doctrinal differences, political disagreement, socio-economic grievance or any other cause,” it said. The NSCIA maintained that all Muslims had equal rights in mosques and that no worshipper should be intimidated, harassed or attacked under any guise within or around mosque premises. In a specific demand for action against those responsible, the Council urged mosque authorities to assist in identifying perpetrators and provide video recordings of the incidents to law enforcement agencies to facilitate their arrest. It also urged Muslims with grievances to seek redress through dialogue, constructive advocacy, lawful engagement and the courts rather than resorting to violence. “No grievance, however genuine or contrived for expediency, should become a justification for violence or the violation of human dignity or the desecration of the Houses of Allah,” the Council declared. Citing the Qur’an’s injunction against aggression, the NSCIA reminded Muslims of the directive to “cooperate in righteousness and piety, but do not cooperate in sin and aggression” (Qur’an 5:2). The Council also cautioned political actors across party lines, religious leaders, community leaders and members of the public against inflammatory statements and actions capable of escalating tensions or threatening public peace. “They should also stop, henceforth, from desecrating the mosques through acts of violence and desist from embarrassing the nation,” it said. Reaffirming its commitment to peace, justice, dialogue and national unity, the NSCIA said it would continue engaging the government, security agencies and other stakeholders to protect religious freedoms and promote national stability. The Council prayed for the recovery of those injured, comfort for affected persons and lasting peace, security and justice in Nigeria. item.title: Marvel crams every superhero ever into Avengers: Doomsday final trailer
item.description: Rumors have been swirling for days that we'd be getting a final trailer for Avengers: Doomsday , the penultimate film in the MCU’s Phase Six, heralding the end of the so-called “Multiverse Saga.” The rumors were true: Marvel just released the trailer, featuring pretty much every superhero ever represented in the MCU. And it looks like the Avengers will face consequences for messing with the timeline to reverse the blip in End Game . As previously reported , the film takes place 14 months after the events of Thunderbolts* . Per the official logline: “Beloved heroes from three distinct universes will be set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they’ve ever encountered.” Those universes are Earth-616 (the Avengers, Wakandans, and New Avengers), Earth-828 (Fantastic Four), and the “original” X-Men. Cast-wise, we have Avengers favorites Thor (Chris Hemsworth), the new Captain America (Anthony Mackie), Bucky Barnes (Sebastian Stan), Ant-Man (Paul Rudd), Falcon (Danny Ramirez), and Loki (Tom Hiddleston). Then there’s the Wakandan contingent: Shuri as the new Black Panther (Letitia Wright), M’Baku (Winston Duke), and Namor (Tenoch Huerta Mejia), as well as Alex Livinalli as Namor’s ally, Attuma. And, of course, Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom. Read full article Comments

item.title: Simeone sets La Liga record with 345 wins for Atletico Madrid
item.description: By Adegboyega Adeleye Diego Simeone became the manager with the most victories in La Liga history after Atletico Madrid’s 3-0 victory over Getafe on Sunday, taking his tally to 345 wins in the Spanish top flight. Atletico confirmed the milestone in a statement, saying Simeone had moved past club legend Luis Aragonés, who finished his La Liga career with 344 victories. Simeone reached the record in 189 fewer matches than Aragonés. The 56-year-old said he was pleased with the achievement and pointed to the work behind it. “It makes me happy,” Simeone said. “I don’t usually find many things to be happy about, but there is an incredible amount of work behind this.” Atletico said Simeone has won 60 per cent of the league matches he has managed. The Argentine has led the club since December 2011, when Barcelona and Real Madrid were the dominant sides in Spain. Asked about the criticism that his teams are too defensive, Simeone said it was a constant narrative but questioned whether defence alone could account for his record. “This narrative that we’re a defensive team, as if we’re always playing solely to defend. You don’t win 345 matches just by defending. Is that even possible?” he said. Simeone has also won eight trophies with Atletico: two La Liga titles, one Copa del Rey, one Spanish Super Cup, two UEFA Super Cups and two Europa League crowns. The club noted that he has won two more trophies than Aragonés did during his time in charge. His first silverware came in 2012, when Atletico won the Europa League and then the UEFA Super Cup. He guided them to the Copa del Rey in his first full season and their first La Liga title since 1996 the following campaign. Atletico won another league title under him in 2021 and completed a Europa League and UEFA Super Cup double in 2018. Simeone has also taken Atletico to two Champions League finals, losing to city rivals Real Madrid in 2014 and 2016. Atletico have qualified for the Champions League in every full season of his tenure. The record was set as Atletico moved to third in the table after 10 wins from 13 matches. The 56-year-old’s contract expires at the end of the season. The post Simeone sets La Liga record with 345 wins for Atletico Madrid appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: 4 facilities FIFA President says Nigeria must fix to host FIFA World Cup
item.description: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has identified four key infrastructure areas Nigeria must improve to strengthen its chances of hosting the FIFA World Cup in the future. Infantino listed stadiums, hotels, airports and transportation as critical requirements for hosting the global football competition, noting that Nigeria has the resources and potential to pursue the ambition. He made the remarks during an interview with Arise TV, where he assessed Nigeria’s readiness to host the tournament. According to him, although Nigeria is currently not ready to host the competition, ongoing and proposed infrastructure projects could provide a foundation for future ambitions. “Well, the next World Cup will be co-hosted by Morocco, so the World Cup comes back to Africa. The key for hosting the World Cup is the infrastructures: the stadiums, hotels, airports, transportation, and this is where the investment is really needed,” he said. 1. Stadiums Infantino said Nigeria needs to invest in stadium infrastructure, acknowledging ongoing and proposed stadium construction projects across the country. He cited his visits to the National Stadium training centre in Abuja and a stadium in Warri, describing the latter as nice but small. “I visited the National stadium training centre in Abuja, In Warri as well, nice stadium, though small stadium,” he said. 2. Hotels Adequate hotel infrastructure is another requirement for hosting the World Cup. Nigeria would need sufficient accommodation facilities to cater to visiting teams, officials, journalists, supporters and other international visitors. 3. Airports Airport infrastructure is also essential to receiving and facilitating the movement of thousands of international visitors expected during the tournament. 4. Transportation Efficient transportation networks would be needed to connect airports, hotels, stadiums and other tournament facilities, ensuring the smooth movement of teams, officials and spectators. Infantino acknowledged Nigeria’s potential, citing its resources, football passion and willingness to invest in infrastructure. He added that the country could build towards hosting the competition by identifying achievable starting points and gradually expanding its infrastructure capacity. On whether Nigeria was currently ready to host the tournament, Infantino said: “Today, no Nigeria is not ready, but tomorrow, why not? When I look at what is being projected, Nigeria has all its cards in its own hands.” Vanguard News The post 4 facilities FIFA President says Nigeria must fix to host FIFA World Cup appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: 2027: Ogun Accord rejects coalition, says party not for sale
item.description: By James Ogunnaike, Abeokuta The Ogun State chapter of the Accord Party has dismissed claims of a political coalition or endorsement deal with any party ahead of the 2027 general elections, declaring that it is not for sale and remains committed to contesting elections at all levels. The party also warned individuals and groups against using its name to negotiate political alliances or endorse candidates of other parties without the authorisation of its recognised state leadership. The State Chairman, Oke Rotimi Michael, stated this in a statement, insisting that the party had neither entered into a coalition nor reached any agreement to support another political party or its candidates. He said Accord remained committed to its political philosophy, vision and mission of providing credible leadership, promoting people-centred governance and improving the welfare of residents of the state. Michael warned that the party would not allow itself to become an instrument of political bargaining, personal ambition or clandestine negotiations by individuals seeking to advance interests outside its recognised structure. He described Accord as an ideological political platform with a distinct identity and a commitment to the aspirations, economic well-being, security and future of the people. “ACCORD is not a political party built on selfish interests, desperation for power, political bargaining or opportunistic alliances. We are a party with an identity, a mission and a clearly defined vision of providing credible political leadership that will empower Nigerians and improve the living conditions of our people. “Our commitment to people-centred politics is fundamental to who we are. The aspirations of the people, their economic survival, security and future remain at the heart of our political philosophy. These values are not negotiable,” he said. The chairman acknowledged that political consultations, lobbying and negotiations were legitimate aspects of democratic practice but maintained that nobody had the authority to negotiate away the party’s identity, interests or electoral prospects without the approval of its recognised leadership. He also cautioned against attempts by individuals to persuade or induce the party’s candidates to endorse candidates of other political parties outside its established decision-making process. “Let me make it categorically clear: ACCORD Ogun State is not for sale. We have not entered into any political coalition, nor have we reached an agreement to support another political party or its candidates. “Any purported coalition arrangement, political endorsement, agreement or understanding entered into by any individual or group without the authorisation and consent of the recognised Ogun State party leadership under my chairmanship does not represent the position of ACCORD Ogun State,” he said. item.title: Fani-Kayode demands action over Nigerians’ deaths in South Africa
item.description: Nigeria’s Ambassador to South Africa, Femi Fani-Kayode, has called for urgent action over unresolved cases involving the deaths of Nigerians in the country, alleged misconduct by security personnel and growing anti-Nigerian sentiments. Fani-Kayode, in a statement on Monday, said the protection of Nigerians living in South Africa must remain a priority of his diplomatic mission, warning that the pursuit of stronger bilateral relations should not come at the expense of citizens’ safety and welfare. The concerns come amid reports that at least 12 Nigerians have died in South Africa in 2026 in incidents linked to anti-migrant protests, alleged police brutality and attacks reportedly motivated by Afrophobia. The ambassador said Nigeria remained committed to strengthening diplomatic and economic ties with South Africa but would not remain silent over issues threatening the safety, dignity and rights of its citizens. He described relations between the two countries as critical to Africa’s economic integration, political stability and development, noting that cooperation between the continent’s two leading economies was essential to its progress. “The future of Africa is closely tied to the relationship between Nigeria and South Africa. If these two countries fail to work together, it could have significant implications for the continent’s progress,” he said. Fani-Kayode said he had consistently advocated dialogue, mutual respect and stronger bilateral engagement since assuming office. However, he maintained that cordial relations between the two governments should not prevent Nigeria from raising legitimate concerns about the treatment of its citizens. He specifically identified unresolved deaths involving Nigerians, alleged misconduct by some South African security personnel and anti-Nigerian statements by certain groups as matters requiring urgent attention. The envoy also warned against portraying the entire Nigerian community in South Africa negatively because of the alleged criminal activities of a few individuals. He said thousands of Nigerians in the country were law-abiding professionals and entrepreneurs whose contributions should not be undermined by the conduct of a minority. “Thousands of Nigerians in South Africa are law-abiding professionals, including doctors, lawyers, academics and entrepreneurs. A small minority engaged in wrongdoing should not be used to define an entire community,” he said. He further cautioned against treating anti-Nigerian rhetoric from some organisations as representative of the views of the wider South African population. Nevertheless, he described expressions of hostility towards Nigerians as troubling and called for sustained dialogue and engagement to address tensions between the two communities. Fani-Kayode commended Nigerian community organisations in South Africa for their efforts to protect the welfare and interests of citizens, saying their interventions had helped bring their concerns to the attention of

item.title: Nvidia Soars as Huang Returns, Lifting Stocks and Crypto Shares
item.description: Bitcoin Magazine Nvidia Soars as Huang Returns, Lifting Stocks and Crypto Shares Nvidia shares jumped about 35% on Monday after the chipmaker reinstated Jensen Huang as president and CEO, restoring roughly $1 trillion in market value at the open. The stock traded near $169.20 at 10:41 a.m. ET, up from Friday’s close of $125.53, and Wall Street rallied with it. The board voted unanimously to bring Huang back, effective immediately, after what it called a series of discussions and meetings. It said it received input from “senior levels of the United States government” and is confident his return “poses no national security risk.” President Donald Trump had urged the move. Several items remain open. An independent board committee will finish its investigation into reports that Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort, and Huang said he will cooperate. Nvidia also formed a national security and export control committee and is searching for a chief compliance officer. From resignation to reversal Huang resigned on Nov. 11, days after admitting an affair with a woman U.S. officials believe is linked to Chinese intelligence. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress became interim CEO and Harvey Jones became board chair. Nvidia had said it was searching for a permanent successor. The stock slid for seven straight weeks, the longest such streak since 2008. On Friday it plunged 14% after Reuters reported that the SEC is examining the company’s accounting practices. Reuters noted that investigations are not evidence of wrongdoing. Huang’s return reverses most of the losses since his affair became public. The selloff came even after Nvidia reported better-than-expected quarterly results on Nov. 17. For weeks, the board had said it was not considering bringing Huang back, which makes Monday’s announcement a sharp turn for the world’s most closely watched chipmaker. Wall Street and chip stocks rally The Nasdaq Composite rose about 7.4% to near 24,300 at 10:41 a.m. ET, and the S&P 500 gained about 5.4% to near 7,280. The Dow Jones Industrial Average climbed about 3.3%, or more than 1,500 points, to near 49,700. The S&P 500 had fallen seven straight days. Chip stocks followed Nvidia higher. Micron (MU) rose about 21% and Taiwan Semiconductor (TSM) gained about 16%, while Intel (INTC) added about 15%. AMD rose about 9% and Broadcom (AVGO) was up about 3%. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent warned on Sunday that the Fed may be making a “policy mistake” if it overtightens. The central bank meets Dec. 8-9, and a quarter-point increase remains the base case. Bitcoin and crypto stocks follow The bitcoin price climbed to a Monday high near $64,500, according to Bitcoin Magazine Pro data, and was near $63,000 at 10:41 a.m. ET. That is about $8,000 above the weekend low of $55,106, hit at roughly 1:17 a.m. ET on Saturday. Bitcoin had slid with stocks on Friday. Crypto-linked stocks jumped. item.title: Fury reveals schizophrenia diagnosis ahead of Joshua clash
item.description: Tyson Fury has said he was diagnosed with schizophrenia soon after his world title win over Wladimir Klitschko in 2015. “Words can’t explain the darkness I was in,” said the heavyweight boxer. “It was like a living version of the pits of hell. “I thought I would end up in a padded room with the door locked, and that scared me so much. “The anxiety was crippling me. I just could not overcome it and that’s when I went and saw the psychiatrist down in London.” Fury has made the revelations about his mental health in a documentary which will be released by Netflix on Friday. The 38-year-old is preparing for the long-awaited all-British heavyweight fight against Anthony Joshua, a fellow former world champion, in Cardiff on December 11 — a bout that will be broadcast live on Netflix. Fury recalled hearing the radio talking to him, and begging wife Paris to get him out of the hospital because “the Illuminati” wanted him. Following his victory over Klitschko, Fury gained weight and struggled with alcohol and drug addiction. “It got that bad I was hearing voices in my mind,” he said. “I wouldn’t be able to sit and have a conversation because I’d be hearing stuff in my mind. “I didn’t know where to turn and no-one knew what to do. I really needed help, or check into rehab or something. I never got a break from it for years. I wanted to be what I thought was normal again.” After Fury was released from hospital, a diagnosis of schizophrenia and bipolar disorder was confirmed. Fury said a turning point in his life came when he was on a night out for Halloween in 2017. “I looked around and could see all the young people and I thought, ‘I had the world in my hands and I threw it all away, and now I’m a fat mess addicted to alcohol’,” he said. But Fury added he channelled his disgust into a comeback which led him to return to training, focus more on his family and claim another world title when he beat Deontay Wilder in 2020. The post Fury reveals schizophrenia diagnosis ahead of Joshua clash appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Cross River Bank Launches Its First Bitcoin-Backed Loans With LendingUSA
item.description: Bitcoin Magazine Cross River Bank Launches Its First Bitcoin-Backed Loans With LendingUSA Cross River Bank has launched its first bitcoin-backed loans, working with consumer lender LendingUSA to let eligible borrowers take out between $10,000 and $250,000 against their BTC without selling it. The program is the first time Cross River has originated bitcoin-secured loans itself, according to The Block. LendingUSA runs the application platform, and every loan is made by Cross River, a New Jersey state-chartered bank, according to LendingUSA . How the loans work Borrowers can choose a loan-to-value ratio of 30%, 50% or 70%, which sets how much cash they receive against the value of the bitcoin they pledge. LendingUSA defines the ratio as the loan balance divided by the value of the collateral, so a 50% loan against $100,000 of bitcoin would be $50,000. Two repayment options are offered: interest-only or no monthly payments. On an interest-only loan, borrowers make smaller monthly payments that roughly cover interest, with the principal and any remaining interest due at the end of the term. On a no-monthly-payment loan, the full balance plus interest is due at the end. LendingUSA says borrowers can repay early without penalties or fees . Applicants go through a soft credit check, and LendingUSA says approval rests on the crypto being pledged rather than a credit score. The company says funding typically arrives within one to three business days after the collateral is verified. Custody and margin risk A qualified third-party custodian holds the bitcoin for the life of the loan. Once the loan is repaid in full, the collateral is released back to the borrower, according to the company. The terms carry the usual risk of borrowing against a volatile asset. LendingUSA says that if the value of the bitcoin falls, the loan-to-value ratio rises, and borrowers may be asked to add collateral or pay down the debt to avoid liquidation. The company says it will try to notify borrowers first but cannot guarantee it during fast price moves. The timing matters. Bitcoin was trading near $61,000 on Monday morning, so a borrower at the 70% tier would have far less room before a collateral call than one at the 30% tier. Lower ratios leave a bigger cushion but unlock less cash per bitcoin pledged. LendingUSA markets the loans for uses such as debt consolidation, home improvements and large purchases. The company says it has served more than 200,000 borrowers across its lending business, and the crypto product is its first expansion into digital asset-backed loans. A chartered bank joins bitcoin lending Cross River President Evan Russo framed the launch as a natural extension of the bank’s work. “Digital assets have become a meaningful part of how many consumers build and hold wealth, and the financial system must evolve to serve them responsibly,” Russo said in a statement. “Cross River was built on the belief that innovation and trusted infrastructure go hand in hand,”

item.title: Why I will never forget Daniel Amokachi – Hull City owner
item.description: By Enitan Abdultawab Hull City owner Acun Ilıcalı has revealed how his close friendship with former Nigerian international Daniel Amokachi began during the striker’s spell at Turkish club Besiktas, describing their relationship as one that made them “brothers”. Ilıcalı, who was a football reporter covering Besiktas at the time, recalled how he became so close to the club’s players that the coach would sometimes approach him to find out their whereabouts. While speaking on The Overlap Podcast, the Turkish businessman singled out Amokachi as one of the players he shared a particularly close relationship with, adding that the Nigerian trusted him more than other journalists. “One memory from that time I will never forget is Daniel Amokachi. He had played for Everton, so we became brothers with him. Amokachi spoke only to me and nobody else. All the reporters were asking me to let Amokachi speak to them,” Ilıcalı said. He also recalled how much the former Super Eagles striker trusted him, revealing that Amokachi would leave his Mercedes-Benz 500 SL with him whenever he travelled to Nigeria. “He trusted me so much that he would leave his 500 SL when he went to Nigeria. I would drive it to work, and the whole company was shocked. Everyone would ask what it was, and I would say it was my friend’s car,” he added. Ilıcalı also narrated how he once helped Amokachi reach Istanbul in time for a crucial Besiktas fixture against Fenerbahce, despite supporting the latter club. According to him, Amokachi was missing in the days leading up to the derby, leaving the Besiktas coach repeatedly asking about the striker’s whereabouts. On the morning of the match, Amokachi eventually contacted Ilıcalı and disclosed that he had missed his flight and was stranded in London. The Hull City owner admitted that he initially hesitated to inform Besiktas officials because he knew the Nigerian forward could pose a serious threat to his boyhood club. “I asked Daniel where he was, and he said he had missed the flight. I switched the phone off. If I had told the Besiktas directors, they would have brought him by private jet. But Besiktas were playing Fenerbahce, and I am a Fenerbahce fan,” he recalled. However, after considering his position, Ilıcalı decided to inform a Besiktas director, who arranged a private jet to bring Amokachi to Istanbul. The striker arrived at the airport about an hour before the match and was at the stadium roughly 30 to 40 minutes before kick-off. Despite the late arrival, Amokachi made an immediate impact, scoring in the 20th minute of the game. Amokachi joined Besiktas from Everton and made a significant impression during his time in Turkey, recording 25 goals and 23 assists in 112 appearances across all competitions. The post Why I will never forget Daniel Amokachi – Hull City owner appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: US Stocks Surge After Last Week’s Losses, Nvidia +33%
item.description: Wall Street stocks bounced early Monday after last week’s bruising losses, with Nvidia rocketing about 33 percent higher as the artificial intelligence company reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO. Major indices had lost between seven and 10 percent last week in a rout that began with chip companies and extended more broadly. But investors engaged in bargain hunting at the start of a holiday-abbreviated week, with the Nasdaq leading major indices thanks in part to Nvidia’s jump. About 35 minutes into trading, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 2.8 percent at 49,499.93. The broad-based S&P 500 gained 4.7 percent to 7231.63, while the tech-rich Nasdaq Composite Index jumped 6.6 percent to 24,107.54. This combo photo shows the Nvidia logo and CEO Jensen Huang at a press conference with Japanese multinational information and communications technology company Fujitsu in Tokyo on July 16, 2026. Photo by PHILIP FONG / AFP Nvidia’s bombshell announcement came about 30 minutes before stock exchange opened. Futures had already been signaling a rebound session, but gains increased after Nvidia brought back Huang following input from senior US government officials that left its board confident Huang posed no national security risk. Briefing.com analyst Patrick O’Hare said the factors that have pressured stocks in recent weeks are still present, including worries about how to finance the artificial intelligence buildout, which has exacerbated inflation and boosted the odds of Federal Reserve interest rate hikes. “Those things will come back into focus, but they’re being set aside given the giddiness of the Jensen Huang news,” O’Hare said. item.title: ‘It wasn’t me’, APC chair disowns letter asking INEC to ensure Tinubu’s victory
item.description: By Omeiza Ajayi ABUJA: National Chairman of the ruling All Progressives Congress APC, Professor Nentawe Yilwatda, has denied writing the Independent National Electoral Commission INEC to ensure President Bola Tinubu is declared winner of the 2027 presidential election. He said he did not author the letter which is now circulating on social media. His spokesman said the document “did not emanate from Professor Yilwatda, was not authored by him, and has absolutely nothing to do with the National Chairman or his office.” In a statement signed by Mr Abimbola Tooki, Special Adviser to the National Chairman of APC (Media and Information Strategy), the party leader described the letter as “a fraudulent document, a malicious fabrication and a reckless attempt to impugn the integrity of the National Chairman, the APC and the democratic process.” The purported letter, addressed to the Chairman of INEC and dated November 22, 2026, is titled “Preparations for the 2027 Presidential Election and Ensuring the Victory of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu.” The APC said it contains “an outrageous and entirely fabricated claim that the APC leadership expects INEC to deploy its institutional mechanisms, administrative frameworks and operational capacities to ensure the declaration of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu as the winner of the 2027 presidential election. “The absence of a signature is particularly telling. It is a glaring indication of the writer’s lack of credibility, accountability and seriousness, and reinforces the suspicion that the document was deliberately concocted to mislead the public, provoke needless controversy and damage the reputation of the Party’s National Chairman,” the statement said. It added that the author “has demonstrated a disturbing level of irresponsibility, dishonesty and desperation by attempting to manufacture a scandal around the APC leadership and the nation’s electoral institution.” The APC also said the letter breaks with the party’s own procedures. “It is inconceivable that a communication of such grave significance would be issued by the National Chairman outside the established channels and procedures of the Party,” the statement said. It challenged those behind the document to identify themselves. “We condemn the author of this despicable letter in the strongest possible terms and challenge those responsible to come out of hiding, take ownership of their actions and provide verifiable evidence for their claims, rather than hiding behind anonymity to spread falsehoods and create distrust in democratic institutions,” it said. The party said the letter runs against its stand on the 2027 polls. “For the avoidance of doubt, the APC remains firmly committed to a peaceful, transparent, free and fair electoral process in the forthcoming 2027 general elections. “Our Party believes in the sanctity of the ballot, the independence of INEC and the right of Nigerians to freely choose their leaders without intimidation, manipulation or interfe

item.title: Bayelsa, Rivers peace will attract investors, says AIG
item.description: …Assures residents of free, fair 2027 elections By Samuel Oyadongha, Yenagoa YENAGOA — The Assistant Inspector-General of Police in charge of Zone 16, Regina Udoette, has said the prevailing peace and security in Bayelsa and Rivers states will attract investors and boost economic activities. Udoette, the 13th AIG to head the zone, made the declaration during a familiarisation visit to the Bayelsa State Police Command, where she commended the leadership of the police commands in both states for their efforts in maintaining security. She said the relative stability in the two states showed that the police, other security agencies and state governments had created an enabling environment for businesses and investments to thrive. According to her, the security arrangements in the states reflected the commitment of the Commissioners of Police, state governments and other stakeholders to promoting economic growth. “Rivers and Bayelsa are safe for everyone to work and invest,” she said. On the 2027 general elections, the AIG assured residents of Bayelsa and Rivers that the Nigeria Police Force, in collaboration with other security agencies, would ensure a free and fair electoral process. She said security personnel would remain neutral and non-partisan throughout the exercise, warning that officers found violating the directive would face severe disciplinary action. “The 2027 election is not the first election to be supervised by the Nigerian Police. In 2023, the performance of the Nigerian Police and other security agencies was commended by election observers. We will also deliver on the 2027 poll,” she said. Earlier, the Bayelsa State Commissioner of Police, Ajao Saka Adewale, said the state’s geographical peculiarities posed significant policing challenges, particularly in the areas of accessibility, surveillance and rapid response. He explained that Bayelsa comprises 25 per cent landmass and 75 per cent water, with 28 police divisions and five tactical teams. Despite the challenges, Adewale said the command had sustained efforts to tackle security threats, particularly cultism and drug-related crimes, through proactive and intelligence-driven policing. He said the command had also strengthened inter-agency collaboration, increased police visibility and deepened engagement with communities. Giving an account of the command’s recent operations, Adewale disclosed that a kidnapped victim had been rescued and a suspected kidnapper arrested since he assumed office on August 12, 2026. “Between September 23, 2026 and October 8, 2026, the command arrested 24 cultists and all have been arraigned in court,” he said. He added that the command had recovered eight firearms, comprising two locally made pistols, three Beretta pistols and three locally made revolver pistols.
